evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: This call will just take around ten to fifteen minutes then I will be able to build you an accurate code you can depend on is now a good time? [James: Yes. Yes. That's perfect.]
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: I'd like to ask first what are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: James raised concern about latest scheduling time (5:30 PM cutoff). Nicole answered it directly but did not ask follow-up probing like 'tell me more about that' or explore underlying constraints.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: Thank you so much for providing your concerns [singular acknowledgment, not a full summary reflection with confirmation]

evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: For a typical one bedroom apartment we usually expect to see around fifteen to 25 boxes to move. Do you think you'll fall within that range?
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not asked. Nicole discussed how items will be handled but never asked 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: $612 to $714 for 3 to 3.5 hours, anchored to typical 1BR move time and personalized to second-floor-to-first-floor 15-minute local move.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full disclosure: $204/hour rate, what's included (fuel, truck, taxes, insurance, pads, tools), explicit no hidden fees (no credit card fees, no transportation fees, no sterile fees, no disassembly/reassembly fees), 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Nicole never asked 'Does that feel fair?' after giving the estimate. She moved directly to explaining factors that affect move time.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: If we cannot make it in the time window that we arrange, we immediately start discounting money off your final bill, and the time starts as soon as we get on site and open the contract.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: We have no worries damage coverage. We provide up to $2,000 per move to repair replace or reimburse for any accidental damages. [No explicit statement about no deductible/no fine print, but $2,000 coverage and repair/replace/reimburse framing present].
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Nicole does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent closure question after covering the two promises.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Do you have any questions or anything for me before I let you go? [Throwaway version, not 'What's still concerning you about this move?']
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Would you like our help with your move tomorrow?
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: No deposit required if you have to reschedule or cancel, no fees for that either.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Moving day confirmed (tomorrow, 8:30 AM slot booked). Phone/text capability confirmed (customer to text). Email confirmed (JMA.C.Holt@gmail.com). top_strength: Nicole gathered comprehensive logistics details (property type, floor/elevator, distances using school bus reference, special items, TV size) and delivered a fully-framed, personalized estimate ($612–$714 anchored to typical 1BR time) with complete fee transparency and both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) fully articulated.
coaching_note: After giving the estimate, ask 'Does that feel fair?' and hold silence for the customer's reaction — do not move to explaining factors until they respond; also ask 'What's still concerning you about this move?' (not 'Any questions?') in Section 6, and confirm specific crew arrival window and document mobility/TV concerns in the booking details for the crew.
